Build a sex-structured operating model

Source: R/sex_om.R
om_sex.Rd

Starts each iteration from the equilibrium at its first-year apical F and projects the stock with FLasher under apical F (effort) and lognormal recruitment deviations. Recruits are split equally between the sexes; spawning biomass is female. The F trajectories can come from FLRef::fudc() (see fapic_fudc()) and the deviations from FLCore::rlnormar1(), as in the FLicc MSE operating models.

Usage

om_sex(
  stk,
  sr,
  fapic,
  years = as.numeric(dimnames(stk)$year),
  nsim = NULL,
  deviances = NULL,
  sigR = 0.5,
  rho = 0,
  seed = 1,
  gtg = NULL
)

Arguments

stk

sex-structured FLStock from stock_sex().

sr

stock-recruitment from sr_sex().

fapic

apical F by year: a numeric vector over years (same for all iterations) or an FLQuant with years (and iterations), e.g. from fapic_fudc().

years

years (default the stock's years).

nsim

iterations (default the iterations of fapic or deviances, else 1).

deviances

optional FLQuant of recruitment deviations (multipliers, e.g. from FLCore::rlnormar1()); otherwise generated from sigR, rho.

sigR

recruitment SD (log scale).

rho

recruitment autocorrelation.

seed

random seed (for generated deviations).

gtg

growth morphs: gtg_settings() (or a list of its arguments, or TRUE) or gtg_sex(). With gtg, each sex's morphs are tracked through the apical F history (fleets select at length, so fast growers are removed sooner), and the population is projected with the resulting effective F, weight and maturity at age; reference points come from the morph equilibrium (refpts_sex_gtg()), true SPR and length samples (lfd_sex()) from the morphs. Use sr_sex() with the same gtg so that B0 matches the morphs.

Value

a list of class floss_om_sex (with gtg: element gtg with the morph structures G, the per-recruit morph tracks and recruitment): stock (FLStockR with units F, M and refpts), sr, refpts (refpts_sex()), fapic (FLQuant, year x iter), lh, lens, sel, sel_fleet (for lfd_sex()) and truth (by year and iteration: apical F, F/Fmsy, female SSB, SSB/B0, SSB/Bmsy, female SPR at the year's F, catch, recruits).
